title: Rolling window blink detector and blink rate calculator
description: Implement engine/blink_detector.py to detect individual blink events (rapid closure and opening cycle between 100ms and 400ms) and calculate rolling blink rate per minute over a 60-second window.
acceptanceCriteria: Differentiates momentary blinks (100ms-400ms) from prolonged closures (> 1000ms)
Maintains a rolling timestamped history of blinks over configurable window (default 60 seconds)
Unit tests verify blink detection on simulated sequences of open-close-open frames

steps.details: Create engine/blink_detector.py with BlinkDetector maintaining state, closure_start_time, and deque of recent blink timestamps.

steps.description: Implement update method with frame closure state
steps.details: Implement update(is_closed: bool, timestamp: float). On closure transition to open: if duration is between min_blink (0.1s) and max_blink (0.4s), record a blink event.
Implement get_blink_rate_per_minute() pruning events older than window (e.g. 60s) and scaling count to rate/min.
Create tests/test_blink_detector.py verifying standard blinks increment count, while continuous open or long closure does not register as a blink.

technicalNotes: Do not classify blinks as drowsiness; blinks are a natural physiological signal to measure alertness frequency.
